a.lede: iFixit's teardown of the iPhone Duo has arrived and it's especially interesting because of the device's complex folding display.

b.lede: Following reports of iPhone Duos with cracked and broken inside screens, often showing a bright line running from the center to the right side, Apple says in a statement to Bloomberg and 9to5Mac that it's aware of "an issue impacting the inner display" on a "small number of iPhone Duo units."
